content.value: Suppose, one of your friends is planning to build a Machine Learning (ML) model to predict the diseases of many patients from various symptoms. He wants to sell the product to several hospitals. He has only 400 instances of data from 300 different patients. The dataset has both categorical and continuous features. There are only 5 diseases for prediction. Which ML model would you suggest to your friend and why?
